Buncombe County

Buncombe County sits in the Blue Ridge Mountains of western North Carolina, centered on Asheville, with smaller mountain towns like Black Mountain and Weaverville ringing the French Broad River valley. Tourism, healthcare, and craft breweries anchor the economy, and post-Helene rebuilding has reshaped the market, with floodplain remapping and steep-slope development ordinances now central to what can be built or insured along the river corridors.
Source: U.S. Census Bureau · Data verified: August 31, 2026
